$comment: Requests that legitimately outlast the default client deadline (#2522, #2577). Both transports read this table: the browser's (apps/web/src/api-transport.ts) and the desktop's (apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/remote_transport.rs), and each maps a budget to its own deadlines. Routes match on the path before any query; ':id' is one non-empty path segment. 'unlessQuery' narrows an entry to requests without that query parameter. Budgets: 'sessionRetitle' waits on the session-naming deadline chain (up to 33s); 'serverBoundUpTo60s' and 'serverBoundUpTo150s' are server bounds of at most 60s and 150s; 'unboundedServerWait' is a wait the server bounds in minutes or not at all, before it sends anything; 'unboundedDownload' answers promptly with a body whose size the client cannot bound.
